title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 059
review_goal: Differentiate filter, fingerprint, and flask variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Cup shaped funnel filter with an oval rim and short lower stem
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a cup shaped funnel with an oval rim rather than straight funnel sides.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the pointed funnel or stacked bars when the top should read as a cup rim.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot opens the top into an oval rim and shortens the lower stem.

items.depicts_observation: Fingerprint swirl with three open curved ridge line traces inside one centered spiral
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simpler fingerprint swirl with three main ridge lines.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the denser fingerprint when a fourth outer ridge line should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses three clear ridge paths curling inward toward the center.

items.depicts_observation: Fingerprint swirl with four open curved ridge line traces inside one centered spiral
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a fuller fingerprint swirl with four visible ridge lines.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler fingerprint when only three ridge bands should appear.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds one more outer ridge line around the same swirling print pattern.

items.depicts_observation: Chemistry flask with a narrow neck above a wide triangular base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a conical chemistry flask with a narrow neck and broad base.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the beaker page or round bottom flask when the body should taper to angled sides.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a classic triangular lab flask with one slim neck.

items.depicts_observation: Tall laboratory beaker with a folded lip and three inner measure line marks inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tall beaker with side measurement lines and a folded lip.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the triangular flask or round bottom flask when the body should stay rectangular.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a tall rectangular beaker with three short measuring lines inside.
